name: Camp Clearbrook
description_short: A part-day YMCA camp (9:00 AM–2:00 PM) at Clearbrook Swim Club in Framingham for kids entering grades 1–6. Families can pick 2, 3 or 5 days a week. Days include swim lessons, free swim, arts and crafts, sports, camp games and social-emotional learning activities.
refund_policy_summary: You pay a non-refundable $50 deposit per week, per child. Deposits can be moved to other camps before April 1 but not after. The deadline to cancel or transfer is May 31. After that there are no refunds, credits or transfers. Changes must be requested in writing by email. A credit or refund (minus the deposit) may be given for an illness or injury lasting 3 or more days if you send a doctor's note before the session ends.
special_needs_notes: The YMCA aims to include all children and asks families to share any needs ahead of time so staff can plan. It says it is not a therapeutic or special needs organization and cannot provide specialized levels of support. Contact the Director of Inclusion, Laina Abolfazli: (508) 876-6094, labolfazli@metrowestymca.org.
swim_waterfront_notes: The site has a large outdoor pool and a splash pad. Campers get daily swim lessons and a recreational swim. They take a swim evaluation on the first day ("Test. Evaluate. Protect."; new campers are tested on Mondays, with retests on Fridays or on request) and get a necklace showing which parts of the pool they may use. Red-neckband swimmers must wear a Coast Guard-approved flotation device during open swim.
